text: In Costa Rica, Floribet Mora had an aneurism at the base of her brain and could not have surgery. She prayed for Blessed John Paul II. A doctor said the Church has accepted the cure. Day 1 of the Novena to St. John Paul II. Pope Francis canonized him on April 27, 2014, in St. Peter's Square, with John XXIII. October 22 is his optional memorial in the United States. These days start on October 13. This reel's words are narration, not a published church prayer. Ask his intercession. Do not treat a cure as something owed. Search Saint Match on the App Store. Feel it. Match a saint who lived it.
